name: hrms-ats
description: Production-grade HRMS + ATS platform built from scratch (Next.js + NestJS + PostgreSQL)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run start:dev --workspace backend" "npm run dev --workspace frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace shared && npm run build --workspace backend && npm run build --workspace frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace backend && npm run lint --workspace frontend
